# team-workspace (deliberately broken demo)

A small B2B team workspace in the shape AI app builders generate: Next.js App Router, Supabase
with organizations, members, invitations and projects, Stripe billing per organization. It was
written by hand for the prelaunch-audit-report tests and has **security holes on purpose**. The
ground truth is in `../team-workspace-app.holes.json`. All names and data are made up. Never deploy it.
